Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 A role without the Litigation right is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller does not hold the Litigation right of the operation
    When the action is taken
    Then the system answers 403 before any read or write and shows MSG-P4-002
    Then nothing changes and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC6 A statement outside this service's schema is refused (BR1, BR3, BR4, BR5, X9) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a treatment row, a recovery_case row, a rule_row or another service's schema
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC7 No personal data enters the record, a log or a workflow input (BR8) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the proposal carries a person name, an address or a contact value
    When the proposal is routed
    Then none of them enters rwb_litigation, the decision record, a log or a workflow input

  Scenario: AC8 A repeated proposal writes once (BR7, X7) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the same proposal arrives twice
    When the proposal is received
    Then one write, one booking request, one case-move answer and one decision record are made, and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC9 The decision record is written before the step acts (BR2) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision log entry can be written
    When the proposal is routed
    Then the record with the rule ID and the rule package version is written before any change or booking request

  Scenario: AC10 Rule R-LIT-38 returns the stage on rejection (BR11) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the approver rejects the settlement with a reason
    When the approval is answered
    Then the stage returns to IN_HEARING and nothing is booked

  Scenario: AC11 The approver and the limit come from rwb-decision (BR6) (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock returns the approver at "D7.4" for case "RC-2026-000713"
    When the proposal is routed
    Then the step routes the proposal to that approver and reads the approval answer, and this service holds no limit of its own
